messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated SIGSEGV/CUDA_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS on runtime-gpu-pool-5 (detected 12 events in 60s). Trigger: cuda-illegal-access-rate > 10/min. Pager: alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): seeing the same in the dashboard — p95 latency spiking too. linking logs now. @carla can you triage kernel vs model? :thinking_face:

ben (sre): I'm pulling node metrics. I'm seeing memory thrashing and a flurry of cgroup OOM kills around the same time. Might be eviction sequence + misaligned kernel pointer in the driver.

carla (runtime): thanks @ben. can you paste the crash stub? I want to check whether it's coming from our compiled kernels or cudnn.

ben (sre): paste logs:
```
[2026-03-15T21:07:02Z] runtime-gpu-5 kubelet: container runtime panic: CUDA illegal memory access at 0x7f8a1c00: misaligned addr (pc=0x7f8a1c00)
stack: libtorch::cuda::...
GPU0: 0x3e5f thread 0x11
```

alice (oncall): initial impact: ~3% of infer requests failing with 500s, affects a small subset of models that do long-history attention. customers reporting timeouts to support. tagging S1? @elena what do you think?

elena (pm): customer impact looks limited but creeping; set S2 for now unless we see broader failures. notify customers on affected routes if error rate > 5% for 10m.

dave (support): fielding two tickets from customers using long-chat workflows. They see repeated failures on retries. I'll add them to the incident notes and request logs.

carla (runtime): quick hypothesis: kernel-level race when kv-cache pages are paged during eviction under high concurrency. Might be a misaligned pointer after a pagemap swap. Two mitigations we can do immediately: 1) pin model variant to no-paging / shorter context for affected routes, 2) cordon problematic nodes and force draining.

alice (oncall): doing quick mitigation: routing rule rollback to model-compact-v2 for routes /chat/long-history to reduce sequence length. Applying now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Starting rollout: route patch to redirect /chat/long-history -> model-compact-v2 (canary 100%) by alice. Command: `redwood routes update --route "/chat/long-history" --model model-compact-v2 --force`

alice (oncall): rollout complete. Monitoring error rate. Also cordoning runtime-gpu-pool-5 node-17 to prevent new pods: `kubectl cordon node-17 && kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

ben (sre): cordon/drain started. I see two pods evicted; one pod restarted on gpu-pool-2 and came back healthy. Also bumping throttle to reduce concurrency to affected endpoints: `max_concurrency=8` for model-compact-v2 route.

carla (runtime): while cordoning, I'll collect mini coredumps and run a quick reproduce on a staging node with the same kernel/drivers. If it's a driver bug we'll need to escalate to infra for kernel hotpatch or driver rollback.

dave (support): customers notified: sent note to two affected customers with temporary mitigation steps and ETA for follow-up.

elena (pm): thanks. keep S2 for now. update timeline in incident doc and link customer messages.

ben (sre): preliminary triage: coredump shows illegal read from a freed page inside our attention kernel path. reproducer runs under heavy eviction/churn. Possible race in kv-cache writeback.

carla (runtime): confirmed on a staging repro. Repro steps attached. I'm going to push a quick runtime guard that validates pointer alignment before the device read and falls back to safe copy path. This will add ~5-10% latency for those tokens but should eliminate the crash. I'll open a hotfix PR. @alice please hold scale changes until the patch lands.

alice (oncall): acknowledged. keeping the cordon. I'll monitor errors and keep customers updated.

incident-bot: severity change: S2 -> S1 candidate if error rate rebounds above 5% for 5m.

carla (runtime): hotfix PR created: `github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4820` — rolling patch to runtime image with alignment guard + extra checks. Canarying to gpu-pool-2 (1 pod).

ben (sre): canary pod started. running synthetic load reproducer now.

[~2 minutes later] carla (runtime): canary passed repro. No illegal-access observed under same load for 10m. Pushing wide rollout to gpu pools after 2m stabilization.

alice (oncall): rolling patch to all gpu pools. Releasing routing change back to default model variants after patch stabilizes.

incident-bot: patch rollout started by carla. Tracking: rollout_id=rl-88231.

ben (sre): rolling update progressed. node-17 still cordoned; will uncordon after next maintenance window and kernel-driver audit.

dave (support): customers updated: replacement suggested and ETA included. No new tickets after patch.

carla (runtime): patch fully rolled out. we've removed the alignment-guard after fixing memory reclamation code in follow-up PR to avoid the latency hit; follow-up PR id=4831.

alice (oncall): monitoring shows error rate back to baseline and p95 latency within expected range. Unsetting emergency routing and restoring normal autoscale.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: incident closed by alice (oncall). Root cause: race in kv-cache eviction + misaligned device read in custom attention kernel leading to CUDA illegal memory access. Mitigations: hotfix alignment guard, routing rollback, node cordon/drain. Postmortem owner: carla (runtime). Deadline for postmortem draft: 72h.

elena (pm): good work team. please include customer timeline and decision log in postmortem.

alice (oncall): handing off to carla for postmortem. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
